### The Day of the Lord for Babylon
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/day-lord-babylon
Passage: Isaiah 13:9
Points:
- God revealed Babylon's ultimate destruction in advance to give His people enduring hope under impending exile.
- Isaiah describes Babylon’s downfall with cosmic imagery that foreshadows the final Day of the Lord.
- The darkening of the sun, moon, and stars symbolizes the humiliation of Babylon's pagan deities before the one true God.
- Earthly powers and spiritual enemies rage against God's kingdom, but their absolute defeat at history's end is guaranteed.
